confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Tel Aviv price levels, not from live listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies with July demand and event timing. FX rate taken from a search-result summary of the RBA page; I did not open the RBA page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Tel Aviv is priced as a high-cost Eastern Mediterranean city, benchmarked loosely against high-cost Western European coastal cities for restaurants and against Israeli and Mediterranean tourist-hotel pricing for accommodation. Accommodation anchors reflect July high-season rates including VAT and tourist fees.
